title: Attention Is All You Need for Chinese Word Segmentation
answer_short: Gaussian-masked directional multi-head attention pays attention to adjacent characters using a fixed Gaussian weight based on distance, capturing localness and directional information.
answer_rationale: The Gaussian-masked directional multi-head attention is designed to focus on adjacent characters by applying a Gaussian weight that depends on the distance between characters, as stated in Text 2. This mechanism enhances the model's ability to capture localness and directional information, which is crucial for tasks like Chinese word segmentation, as mentioned in Text 3 and Text 7. It modifies standard scaled dot-product attention by incorporating a directional Gaussian mask, as explained in Text 10 and Text 9.
